name: cypress-react-e2e-component
description: Simple interactive React app with Cypress 14 E2E + component tests

scripts.sl:config: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug npx slnodejs config --appname cypress-ct-demo --branch master --build 1.0.0
scripts.sl:scan: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug npx slnodejs scan --workspacepath dist --scm none --instrumentForBrowsers --outputpath sl-dist
scripts.sl:runner: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug CYPRESS_SL_TOKEN=$(cat sltoken.txt) CYPRESS_SL_BUILD_SESSION_ID=$(cat buildSessionId) CYPRESS_SL_TEST_STAGE=e2e-runner CYPRESS_SL_ENABLE_REMOTE_AGENT=true npx sealights-cypress-plugin npx cypress run --spec 'cypress/e2e/sub/*'
scripts.sl:coverage: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug npx slnodejs nycReport --testStage ct-spec
scripts.cy:e2e:sl: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug CYPRESS_SL_TOKEN=$(cat sltoken.txt) CYPRESS_SL_BUILD_SESSION_ID=$(cat buildSessionId) CYPRESS_SL_TEST_STAGE=e2e CYPRESS_SL_ENABLE_REMOTE_AGENT=true cypress run --e2e
scripts.cy:e2e:sl:spec: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug CYPRESS_SL_TOKEN=$(cat sltoken.txt) CYPRESS_SL_BUILD_SESSION_ID=$(cat buildSessionId) CYPRESS_SL_TEST_STAGE=e2e-spec CYPRESS_SL_ENABLE_REMOTE_AGENT=true CYPRESS_SL_SPEC='cypress/e2e/sub/*' cypress run --e2e --spec 'cypress/e2e/sub/*'
scripts.cy:ct:sl: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug CYPRESS_SL_TOKEN=$(cat sltoken.txt) CYPRESS_SL_BUILD_SESSION_ID=$(cat buildSessionId) CYPRESS_SL_TEST_STAGE=ct CYPRESS_SL_ENABLE_REMOTE_AGENT=true CYPRESS_SL_SPEC=cypress/component2/**/*.cy.{js,jsx,ts,tsx} cypress run --component
scripts.cy:ct:sl:spec: NODE_DEBUG=sl SL_LOG_LEVEL=debug CYPRESS_SL_TOKEN=$(cat sltoken.txt) CYPRESS_SL_BUILD_SESSION_ID=$(cat buildSessionId) CYPRESS_SL_TEST_STAGE=ct-spec CYPRESS_SL_ENABLE_REMOTE_AGENT=true CYPRESS_SL_SPEC='cypress/component/sub/*' cypress run --component --spec 'cypress/component/sub/*'
